title: NAZDEEK NAJAF HAI KO! HAIDAR KO BULALE
body:
Yu'n Maadare Shabbir pareshaan hai bann me
Rothi hai tadapti hai wo hairaan hai bannme
Kehti hai ke duniya Meri veeraan hai bannme
<<MINI>>
Hai LaalMera aaj laeeno'n ke hawaale
Nazdeek Najaf hai koi Haidar ko bulale
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar ek hai lekin hain talabgaar hazaaron
Tanha Mera Shabbir sitamgaar hazaaron
Ek jaan pa toote hain jafa kaar hazaaron
<<MINI>>
Hai LaalMera aaj laeeno'n ke hawaale
Nazdeek Najaf hai koi Haidar ko bulale
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazloom ke bachne ki koi aas nahi'n hai
Sab margaye hamdard koi paas nahi'n hai
Akbar nahi'n Qasim nahi'n Abbas nahi'n hai
<<MINI>>
Hai LaalMera aaj laeeno'n ke hawaale
Nazdeek Najaf hai koi Haidar ko bulale
<<DIVIDER>>
Badhte huwe aate hain idhar barchhion waale
Koi bhi nahi'n jo MereBachche ko bachaale
Hai koi jo is Maadare bekas ki Dua le
<<MINI>>
Hai LaalMera aaj laeeno'n ke hawaale
Nazdeek Najaf hai koi Haidar ko bullae
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadd'haif wo hai nargha-e aada me giraftaar
Teero'n ki hai bochhaar to shamsheer ke hain waar
Lo jhoomta hai pushte faras par MeraDildaar
<<MINI>>
Hai LaalMera aaj laeeno'n ke hawaale
Nazdeek Najaf hai koi Haidar ko bulale
<<DIVIDER>>
Hilti hai zami'n aur falak hota hai larzaa'n
Khaime se nikal aayi hai Zainab suwe Maida'n
Hone laga Bachche ke Mere qatl ka saamaa'n
<<MINI>>
Hai LaalMera aaj laeeno'n ke hawaale
Nazdeek Najaf hai koi Haidar ko bulale
<<DIVIDER>>
Baade Shahe Mazloom Mujahid ye hua tha
Sab jal gaye khaime ye falak dekh raha tha
Naoha yehi Zehra ka faqat goonj raha tha
<<MINI>>
Hai LaalMera aaj laeeno'n ke hawaale
Nazdeek Najaf hai koi Haidar ko bulale
author: Mujahid Hussain
